chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Husayn al-Khallal, from his grandfather, who said:

I asked al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), 'Where did you bury the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'We carried him out at night. We passed the mosque of al-Ash'ath and then moved toward the area behind Gharī.'

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: Where was Imam Ali (peace be upon him) buried according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* provides a key geographical marker for the traditional Shia location of Imam Ali’s grave in Najaf, specifically identifying the area behind the Mosque of al-Ash'ath in Gharī. It highlights the secrecy of the burial to protect the Imam’s body from political rivals, a detail that underscores the historical context of the Umayyad threat during the early 8th century.
